description: Downloads the Probe binary from its GitHub release (checksum-verified) and, when Docker is running, pulls the sandbox base images. It never installs system software: for Docker, OpenShell or Python it returns the exact command and its caveats (admin rights, restarts, licensing) for you to show the user and run only with their permission. Pulling all images can take a few minutes; pass `languages` to pull only what the tool needs.

languages.description: Sandbox images to pull. Default: all four.

pull_images.description: Pull the sandbox images when Docker is running. Default true.

name: probe_install
title: Install Probe's own pieces
